## Accepted partial audits; target unresolved in this work

Problem 30005388 asks whether the Kang–Park A invariant equals Arf on all smooth concordance torsion. Five scoped partial routes are accepted: the residual additive character, formal long-box obstruction and repair, literal figure-eight tensor-square maps, surgery nonadditivity, and a certified two-torsion family with its missing involution computation identified. The proof-search budget is exhausted at 5/5. There is no full proof, actual-knot counterexample, novelty claim, or worldwide-openness claim.

## Material verifier correction

The original verifier could return PASS after omission of the derivative correction in the tensor law, using substitute solver maps. It did not test the tensor matrix’s horizontal square axiom or the report’s literal certificates. The mathematical reports already use the correct tensor law.

The delivered verify_hardened.py checks the tensor grading, square axiom, derivative commutation, and the literal inclusion/projection support ad,bc,cb,da,xx. The separate independent_verify.py uses vector actions and exhaustive finite enumeration without importing the first checker. Both positive outputs match the accepted exact results byte-for-byte in normal, -O, and -OO modes.

The report trio and independent audit are preserved byte-for-byte. CORRECTION_NOTICE.md distinguishes their historical execution descriptions from the new delivery. The full flawed original verifier is omitted. Its prior false acceptances are clearly labeled historical evidence; their replay and historical contextual patch application are NOT_RUN.

## Target-only scope

Only new files beneath `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005388/`: authored reports/audit/correction, acceptance/status, corrected and independent finite checkers, exact-output evidence, public source metadata, and fixed-bootstrap verification support. No queue content or edits. No source documents or copied source text, dataset contents, private sources, private coordination material, or their identifying metadata. Draft only; no merge, release, DOI, or outreach.

Public scholarly metadata records earlier retrieval/inspection and does not claim a fresh byte download, fresh source-body replay, or a new manuscript-status search.

## Fixed external trust anchor and final evidence

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py externally before execution. Its fixed pins bind the manifest, verifier, and controls harness. The manifest authenticates the entire remaining delivery, including acceptance and all pre-seal receipts. A replacement manifest supplied by the candidate does not replace the external trust anchor.

- BOOTSTRAP.py SHA-256: `5dda0e269a6fd0813a4ff2a8cbe9a4f14c49ddcb5b5fe2ea65aa854335cdaf55`
- PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json SHA-256: `7d397e7e4a24e7ef126bb9b4213a74f0a1e79ee5897d0b9bfc0c436999c2278f`
- verify_publication.py SHA-256: `359dec9f0cddc9c025f5e62d00bd8cb8a0c89fd3549f5340270b1cb504c83aeb`
- MUTATION_TESTS.py SHA-256: `7d13e695494e3a11527b6395ed74e66f96446c658236a8dcf4d35598b3047734`

Fresh complete mathematical stdout and stderr equal mode-specific pinned references byte-for-byte, with recursive exact JSON types and no normalization. Current checks include 44 matrix-model parameter choices, 80 independent vector-model choices, the literal tensor certificates, trefoil V0 values 1 and 1, determinant parity controls, and the torsion-only rank criterion. The finite checks do not establish the all-knots target or recognition of actual knot complexes.

The final fixed external bootstrap ran under actual UID=EUID=1000 with packet files 0444 and directory 0555. Real append/create probes were denied. Intended semantic code mutations ran directly on authenticated disposable read-only copies; a manifest mismatch was not counted as mathematical rejection.

- normal: exit 0; 23 mathematical negatives (10 actual code mutations), 62 integrity negatives, 75 schema/scope negatives, 31 direct-comparator negatives; 46 whole-packet and 46 semantic-fixture physical EACCES denials. Hostile baseline stdout/stderr equal clean baseline exactly. Full final stdout SHA-256 `f06f26546e785cab50ce6b55ade2db49e9519c300c519592c290e368ef11556a` (130022 bytes); stderr empty.
- O: exit 0; 23 mathematical negatives (10 actual code mutations), 62 integrity negatives, 75 schema/scope negatives, 31 direct-comparator negatives; 46 whole-packet and 46 semantic-fixture physical EACCES denials. Hostile baseline stdout/stderr equal clean baseline exactly. Full final stdout SHA-256 `de81e65de229a3a8df9abb3dae3d5fac31eccb23d731bdc7a2410ee6a05cb904` (130022 bytes); stderr empty.
- OO: exit 0; 23 mathematical negatives (10 actual code mutations), 62 integrity negatives, 75 schema/scope negatives, 31 direct-comparator negatives; 46 whole-packet and 46 semantic-fixture physical EACCES denials. Hostile baseline stdout/stderr equal clean baseline exactly. Full final stdout SHA-256 `2d9a10f42d6ba1714e39de34d39a77c32fde37bca2c07d9d14329c9624d7c9b4` (130022 bytes); stderr empty.

A second fresh final fixed-bootstrap run also reproduced each mode’s complete 130,022-byte control receipt and empty stderr exactly, including recursive exact JSON types, against the external mode-specific receipt pins above.

All delivered bytes had identical before/after hashes. Hostile Python environment and working-directory injection produced exactly the clean baseline stdout and stderr. Integrity controls cover every member, missing/extra/link/special entries, resealing, and tampered harness execution; schema/comparator controls reject type substitutions, duplicate keys, nonfinite values, partial output, formatting changes, extra stderr, and altered acceptance/status.

Included PREPARATION_CONTROLS receipts describe the earlier pre-seal stage only. Final all-mode receipts are external and pinned above, avoiding circular self-hashes. Original-verifier replay, historical false-acceptance replay, historical patch application, source-body replay, dataset replay, and formal proof-assistant verification are NOT_RUN. Remote publication, exact-commit byte readback and CI are NOT_RUN at preparation; no green-CI claim is made.
title: Audit involutive Arf equality: five partial routes and verifier correction
